question: Where was Global Technology Summit 2022 held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Global Technology Summit 2022 was held in **New Delhi**, India.
 
• It was co-hosted by the **Ministry of External Affairs (MEA)**, Government of India, and Carnegie India.
 
• The event is an annual flagship initiative that focuses on examining the intersection of **technology, economics, and foreign policy**.
 
• The 2022 theme was **"Geopolitics of Technology"**, addressing critical global challenges and opportunities in the tech landscape.
 
• It brought together global policymakers, industry leaders, academia, and researchers to discuss the future of technology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Global Technology Summit**

 
 
• The summit is one of the most prominent forums in India for discussing the role of technology in shaping global policies.
 
• It provides a platform for fostering collaboration between governments and the private sector to address shared challenges.
 
• The event is known for its focus on emerging technologies such as AI, cybersecurity, quantum computing, and space technologies.
 
• Previous editions have emphasized India's growing role in the global technological ecosystem.
 
 
 
• **Carnegie India**
 
 
• It is a premier think tank based in New Delhi, part of the global Carnegie Endowment for International Peace network.
 
• Carnegie India works on issues related to technology policy, security studies, and political economy.
 
• The organization is known for its deep engagement with policymakers and thought leaders globally.
 
 
 
• **Geopolitics of Technology**
 
 
• This concept explores how technology shapes and is shaped by global political and economic power dynamics.
 
• Key areas include competition in AI, semiconductor supply chains, digital trade policies, and the regulation of big tech companies.
 
• The summit highlights how nations can leverage technology to achieve strategic and economic objectives.
 
 
 
• **India's Role in Technology Diplomacy**
 
 
• India is increasingly positioning itself as a global leader in technology and innovation.
 
• Initiatives such as the Digital India campaign and Aadhaar have showcased India's ability to implement large-scale tech solutions.
 
• India's participation in global tech forums underscores its commitment to shaping the future of technology governance.
